CHAPTER.VERS: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
May Jehovah cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?"
"Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says Jehovah; "I will set him in safety from those who malign him."
The words of Jehovah are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
You will keep them, Jehovah. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
